items: `grid-template-columns` defines the column tracks. Each listed size or repeated track describes a column.
A media query only applies its enclosed styles when the stated condition matches. The other styles remain the starting rules.

blocks.text: The content stacks below 48rem. Wider screens show a main column and a smaller side column.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Choose breakpoints where your content needs them, not only from names of popular devices.
